mechanism: Prednisolone may increase haloperidol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction and increase risk of extrapyramidal side effects through CNS effects; haloperidol may impair prednisolone's immunosuppressive efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced haloperidol efficacy and increased extrapyramidal symptoms; consider haloperidol dose adjustment and monitor clinical response; assess need for prednisolone dose optimization.
